text.en: This Order may be cited as the Travel Agents Act (Amendment) Order, 2012 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 7th March 1995. of section 2 of Chapter 103.

Section 2 of the Travel Agents Act, in this Order referred to as the Act, is {a} by deleting the definition of "the Board"; {b} by inserting the following new definition immediately before "Licence"; means such person as is appointed by His Majesty the and Yang Di-Pertuan under section 5(1) to be the Authority for the purposes of this Act;"; {c} in the definition of "Licensee", by deleting the fullstop and by substituting a semicolon therefor; {d) by adding the following new definition .•" means the Minister responsible for the administration of
Section 5 of the Act is repealed and the following new section substituted "Appointment of Authority.
Section 7 of the Act is amended, in subsection (5), by deleting "its" from the second line and by substituting "his" therefor.

( 1) the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan may by notification Gazette, appoint a person to be the Authority for the of this Act.

(2) The Authority may authorise or appoint any person to assist in the exercise of the powers, duties and functions of the Authority under this Act, either generally or in any particular case.

(3) Any person appointed by the Authority under subsection (2) shall be deemed to be a public servant for the purposes of the Penal Code 22).".
Section 18 of the Act is amended by deleting "of the Board" from the first line.

Section 19 of the Act is amended

(a) in paragraph (a), by deleting "any of the officers of the Board authorised" from the first two lines and by substituting "any officer authorised by the Authority" therefor; and

(b) in paragraph (c), by deleting "an officer of the Board" from the second line and by substituting "any officer authorised by the Authority" therefor. of Act.

The Act is amended by deleting "Board" wherever that word appears and by substituting "Authority" therefor. Made this 28th. day of Zulhijjah, 1433 Hijriah corresponding to the of November, 2012 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM _,· Dicetak oleh PENGIRAN HAJI ZAINAL ABIDIN BIN PENGIRAN SERI WIJAYA PENGIRAN HAJI AHMAD, Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam.
